records.source: You found it! Thank you.
records.translation: Nahanap mo iyon! Salamat.

records.source: Just look at our little family... We've come a long way, haven't we?
records.translation: Tingnan mo ang munting pamilya natin... Malayo na ang narating natin, hindi ba?

records.source: Two beautiful children... We've come a long way, haven't we?
records.translation: Dalawang magagandang anak... Malayo na ang narating natin, hindi ba?

records.source: It's so wonderful to welcome little {0} into our life.
records.translation: Napakasayang tanggapin ang munting {0} sa buhay natin.

records.source: Everything went well, and now little {0} is part of the family. We're very fortunate.
records.translation: Naging maayos ang lahat, at bahagi na ngayon ng pamilya ang munting {0}. Napakapalad natin.

records.source: Um... Honey? Why are there monsters in the house?
records.translation: Um... Mahal? Bakit may mga halimaw sa bahay?

records.source: Your new {0} will be finished tomorrow! Are you excited?
records.translation: Matatapos bukas ang bago mong {0}! Nasasabik ka ba?

records.source: Your new {0} will be ready in {1} days. Just pretend I'm not here.
records.translation: Magiging handa ang bago mong {0} sa loob ng {1} araw. Magkunwari ka lang na wala ako rito.

records.source: Your new {0} will be ready in {1} days. I'm going to be working on this thing day and night!
records.translation: Magiging handa ang bago mong {0} sa loob ng {1} araw. Pagtatrabahuhan ko ito araw at gabi!

records.source: Uh.. What are you doing?$s
records.translation: Uh.. Ano ang ginagawa mo?$s

records.source: Hey, don't look in there!$a
records.translation: Hoy, huwag kang tumingin diyan!$a

records.source: Hey, don't even think about it! That's private!$a
records.translation: Hoy, huwag mo ngang isipin! Pribado iyan!$a

records.source: What are you doing? I only allow those I trust to enter there.
records.translation: Ano ang ginagawa mo? Tanging mga pinagkakatiwalaan ko ang pinapayagan kong pumasok doon.

records.source: Hey. Your tool is ready but you don't have any room in your inventory.
records.translation: Hoy. Handa na ang kagamitan mo pero wala kang puwang sa imbentaryo.

records.source: Um, I'm still working on your {0}. It won't be ready today.
records.translation: Um, ginagawa ko pa ang {0} mo. Hindi ito magiging handa ngayon.

records.source: The museum looks amazing! Thanks again for all your help.
records.translation: Napakaganda ng museo! Salamat ulit sa lahat ng tulong mo.

records.source: It doesn't seem like you have anything to donate to the museum. Better get out there and do some treasure hunting, huh?
records.translation: Mukhang wala kang maiaabuloy sa museo. Mas mabuting lumabas ka at mangaso ng kayamanan, ha?

records.source: Hello there! Welcome to the Stardew Valley Archaeological Office.#$b#Uh... This is embarrassing, but the previous curator made off with the entire collection. We don't have any artifacts for display.#$b#But I'm hoping to remedy that soon! Hey, if you find any artifacts or minerals out there... would you let me know?
records.translation: Kumusta! Maligayang pagdating sa Tanggapan ng Arkeolohiya ng Stardew Valley.#$b#Uh... Nakakahiya ito, pero tinangay ng dating tagapangasiwa ang buong koleksiyon. Wala kaming anumang artepakto na maipapakita.#$b#Pero umaasa akong maaayos iyon sa lalong madaling panahon! Hoy, kung makakita ka ng anumang artepakto o mineral doon... ipaaalam mo ba sa akin?

records.source: What happened? You're a club member?!
records.translation: Ano ang nangyari? Miyembro ka ng club?!

records.source: Well, well, well... Look who made it inside my exclusive clubhouse.#$e#You've got the 'spark'... that's why I singled you out.#$e#What spark? Ah... The conduit of mystery, of art...#$b#People like us have a responsibility to keep the world alive, to give folks a taste of the extraordinary.#$e#You see, kid... The world's like a bowl of rice. It's got substance, but it ain't worth nothin' without a good, zesty sauce. That's where we come in.#$b#Didn't you ever wonder who put those treasure chests in the old mineshaft? I like to give people surprises.#$e#You'll understand someday. Just keep doing your best and never give up.
records.translation: Buweno, buweno, buweno... Tingnan mo kung sino ang nakapasok sa eksklusibo kong clubhouse.#$e#Mayroon ka ng 'kislap'... kaya kita pinili.#$e#Anong kislap? Ah... Ang daluyan ng misteryo, ng sining...#$b#May pananagutan ang mga tulad natin na panatilihing buhay ang mundo, na patikimin ang mga tao ng pambihira.#$e#Alam mo, bata... Parang mangkok ng kanin ang mundo. May laman ito, pero walang kabuluhan kung walang masarap at maanghang na sarsa. Diyan tayo may papel.#$b#Hindi mo ba naisip kung sino ang naglagay ng mga baul ng kayamanan sa lumang lagusan ng minahan? Gusto kong nagbibigay ng mga sorpresa sa mga tao.#$e#Maiintindihan mo rin balang araw. Patuloy mo lang gawin ang makakaya mo at huwag kailanman sumuko.

records.source: Thank you! I'll get started tomorrow. I should be finished in around three days.
records.translation: Salamat! Magsisimula ako bukas. Dapat ay matapos ako sa loob ng humigit-kumulang tatlong araw.

records.source: That's so generous of you! I'll start working on the upgrade tomorrow. It should take around three days.
records.translation: Napakabuti mo! Sisimulan ko bukas ang pagpapahusay. Aabutin ito ng humigit-kumulang tatlong araw.

records.source: ...I found you unconscious in the mines. I almost mistook you for a piece of exotic wood!#$b#Be a little more careful next time, okay?$s
records.translation: ...Natagpuan kitang walang malay sa mga minahan. Halos napagkamalan kitang piraso ng kakaibang kahoy!#$b#Mag-ingat ka pa nang kaunti sa susunod, ha?$s

records.source: ...I found you unconscious in the mines. I think I blew my back out, dragging you all the way up here.#$b#Be a little more careful next time, okay?$s
records.translation: ...Natagpuan kitang walang malay sa mga minahan. Sa tingin ko ay napilay ang likod ko sa pagkaladkad sa iyo hanggang dito sa itaas.#$b#Mag-ingat ka pa nang kaunti sa susunod, ha?$s

records.source: ...I found you unconscious in the mines. You were gone so long I started to get worried about you!#$b#Be a little more careful next time, okay?$s
records.translation: ...Natagpuan kitang walang malay sa mga minahan. Napakatagal mong nawala kaya nagsimula akong mag-alala sa iyo!#$b#Mag-ingat ka pa nang kaunti sa susunod, ha?$s

records.source: ...I found you unconscious in the mines. I was hunting for minerals and I almost stepped on your head!#$b#Be a little more careful next time, okay?$s
records.translation: ...Natagpuan kitang walang malay sa mga minahan. Naghahanap ako ng mga mineral at muntik ko nang matapakan ang ulo mo!#$b#Mag-ingat ka pa nang kaunti sa susunod, ha?$s

records.source: ...I found you unconscious in the mines. You're lucky I happened to pass by!#$b#Be a little more careful next time, okay?$s
records.translation: ...Natagpuan kitang walang malay sa mga minahan. Mapalad kang nagkataong napadaan ako!#$b#Mag-ingat ka pa nang kaunti sa susunod, ha?$s

records.source: You were gone so long I started to get worried about you! I started crying when I saw your limp body...$s
records.translation: Napakatagal mong nawala kaya nagsimula akong mag-alala sa iyo! Napaiyak ako nang makita kong nakahandusay ang katawan mo...$s

records.source: You were gone so long I started to get worried about you! I almost had a heart attack when I saw your limp body...$a
records.translation: Napakatagal mong nawala kaya nagsimula akong mag-alala sa iyo! Halos atakihin ako sa puso nang makita kong nakahandusay ang katawan mo...$a

records.source: Excellent! Welcome to Joja Corporation! Come back tomorrow and we can see about getting started on some community development projects... Oh, and don't forget your wallet! Hehe.#$b#Now, let me call Mayor Lewis and see about gutting that nasty old community center...
records.translation: Mahusay! Maligayang pagdating sa Korporasyong Joja! Bumalik ka bukas at maaari nating simulan ang ilang proyekto sa pagpapaunlad ng komunidad... O, at huwag kalimutan ang pitaka mo! Hehe.#$b#Ngayon, tatawagan ko si Alkalde Lewis at titingnan kung maaari nang baklasin ang loob ng pangit at lumang Sentro ng Komunidad...

records.source: Come back tomorrow and we can see about getting some community improvements started... Just make sure to bring a lot of money. Hehe.
records.translation: Bumalik ka bukas at maaari nating simulan ang ilang pagpapabuti sa komunidad... Tiyakin mo lang na magdala ng maraming pera. Hehe.

records.source: Welcome to JojaMart! How are you doing today?#$b#I don't believe we've met. I'm Morris, Joja Customer Satisfaction Representative.#$b#When you decide you want to become a Joja Member, I'll be delighted to help make your transition a joyous experience.
records.translation: Maligayang pagdating sa JojaMart! Kumusta ka ngayon?#$b#Sa tingin ko ay hindi pa tayo nagkikita. Ako si Morris, Kinatawan ng Kasiyahan ng Mamimili ng Joja.#$b#Kapag nagpasya kang maging Miyembro ng Joja, ikagagalak kong tulungan kang gawing masayang karanasan ang paglipat mo.

records.source: Welcome to JojaMart! How is your weekend going?#$b#We're currently in the process of setting up a brand-new membership system for our customers. Please check back soon to join!
records.translation: Maligayang pagdating sa JojaMart! Kumusta ang katapusan ng linggo mo?#$b#Kasalukuyan kaming naghahanda ng bagong-bagong sistema ng pagiging miyembro para sa aming mga mamimili. Bumalik ka sa lalong madaling panahon upang sumali!

records.source: Welcome to JojaMart! How is your weekend going?#$b#Membership is now available! With a Joja Membership, you'll be able to make improvements in the community with the help of our dedicated personnel... for a fee, of course.#$b#Oh, and another thing... Mayor Lewis promised us that if anyone else joined up, he'd let us turn that old community center into a Joja Warehouse. Isn't that wonderful?#$q -1 -1#Membership costs {0}g. Well, would you like to join us?#$r -1 -1 Yes#Yes.#$r -1 -1 No#No.

Sa Pagiging Miyembro ng Joja, makagagawa ka ng mga pagpapabuti sa komunidad sa tulong ng aming masisipag na tauhan... kapalit ng bayad, siyempre.#$b#O, at isa pa... Nangako sa amin si Alkalde Lewis na kung may iba pang sasali, pahihintulutan niya kaming gawing Bodega ng Joja ang lumang Sentro ng Komunidad.
